name.zh: 奥罗波若斯《永劫回归》体系

periods.description: World-rewriting power that altered the parade period and left the heroines with memories of different romantic outcomes with Lux. Its emotional residue directly creates the five-queen settlement.
periods.principles: Ouroboros changes world conditions and memories at a scale beyond ordinary Drag-Ride combat.
limitations: undone outcomes still matter to those who remember
